rule: O is built on the JUDGED profile if its split-half r >= 0.5 in BOTH languages. Otherwise the judged O is EXPLORATORY and the teacher-forced profile e_tf is promoted to primary iff ITS split-half r >= 0.5 in both languages; if neither passes, O is EXPLORATORY and the CONFIRMED verdict is unreachable by construction.
O_definition: O_L(edit) = sum_h e_L(h) g(h) / sqrt(sum_h g(h)^2), g(h) = sum_comp c_(h-1,comp)^2 ||W_comp^T rhat_h||^2 (closed-form per-layer removal energy)

cheap_baselines.single_site_peak: B_site = e_raw_L(h_peak), h_peak = argmax_h g(h): the judged single-site causal drop at the edit's most energetic site (one forward pass per site)
cheap_baselines.single_site_transfer_rate: e_raw_SL(h*) / e_raw_EN(h*) at the frozen site h* = 20 (per model x language; used in the pooled race)
cheap_baselines.unedited_refusal_rate: no-op refusal rate per (model, language) on CONF items (pooled race)

prediction_matched_contrast: within every group, residual SL refusal of the high-O member < low-O member
verdict_rule: CONFIRMED if dR2_O >= 0.10 AND Spearman(O, residual) >= 0.60 in both languages AND O ties or beats both cheap baselines (paired-bootstrap CI on the Spearman difference does not exclude zero against O) AND controls are null AND the argmax band check passes. PARTIAL if O ties the single-site baseline and both beat energy/count/span/cosine. FALSIFIED if dR2_O < 0.05 OR O loses to either cheap baseline with a CI excluding zero. INCONCLUSIVE otherwise (dR2 in [0.05, 0.10) or a CI straddling a bar) - reported with the MDE, never rounded into a verdict.
